name: haxefmod
description: Use FMOD Studio with Haxe on HTML5, HashLink, Windows, Linux, and macOS
releasenote: Cross-platform support for Windows, Linux, and macOS via C++ and HashLink targets. FMOD Engine libraries are now required by the user. Checker script added to help setup process (haxelib run haxefmod check). FMOD 2.03.12 now the officially supported version.
